usage.finalMessage:
I implemented CLIN-22-R1: `book` now takes an optional `follow-up` or `regular` kind, and follow-ups are marked as such in the booking line and in `schedule`. `dotnet test` passes, 7 of 7.
I did not implement R2 (book follow-ups up to 180 days ahead). It conflicts with the accepted rule DEC-C01, which allows 90 days for every kind of appointment, so follow-ups still stop at 90 days.
The conflict is an open question in `.work/report.json` for Clinical Operations and the Scheduling Office to settle; the decisions and report are committed.
OUTCOME: completed
